import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: Contains 2017 year data without Region
df_2017 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

# Load Source 1: Contains 2015 year data with Region and slightly different column names
df_2015 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# --- Step 1: Rename columns in df_2015 to match target schema (2015 columns) ---
df_2015_renamed = df_2015.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# Keep only relevant columns for 2015 data + Region
df_2015_selected = df_2015_renamed[
    ['Country', 'Region', 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
     'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15',
     'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15']
]

# --- Step 2: Rename columns in df_2017 to match target schema (2017 columns) ---
df_2017_renamed = df_2017.rename(columns={
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Happiness_Rank_17',
    'Happiness_Score_17': 'Happiness_Score_17',
    'Whisker_High_17': 'Whisker_High_17',
    'Whisker_Low_17': 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17': 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17': 'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17': 'Life_Expectancy_17',
    'Freedom_17': 'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17': 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17': 'Trust_17',
    'Dystopia_17': 'Dystopia_17'
})

# Keep only relevant columns for 2017 data
df_2017_selected = df_2017_renamed[
    ['Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
     'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
     'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17']
]

# --- Step 3: Merge 2015 and 2017 data on 'Country' ---
# The 2015 data has Region, 2017 data does not, so we keep Region from 2015
df_merged = pd.merge(df_2015_selected, df_2017_selected, on='Country', how='inner')

# --- Step 4: Reorder columns to match target schema exactly ---
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# --- Step 5: Ensure correct data types ---
df_final = df_final.astype({
    'Country': str,
    'Region': str,
    'Happiness_Rank_15': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_15': float,
    'Standard_Error_15': float,
    'Economy_15': float,
    'Family_15': float,
    'Life_Expectancy_15': float,
    'Freedom_15': float,
    'Trust_15': float,
    'Generosity_15': float,
    'Dystopia_15': float,
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_17': float,
    'Whisker_High_17': float,
    'Whisker_Low_17': float,
    'Economy_17': float,
    'Family_17': float,
    'Life_Expectancy_17': float,
    'Freedom_17': float,
    'Generosity_17': float,
    'Trust_17': float,
    'Dystopia_17': float
})

# --- Step 6: Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file ---
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {output_path}")
